summary: Marex Group Limited (New Marex) filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, reporting the completion of a redomiciliation and reorganization effective July 1, 2026. Under a scheme of arrangement, holders of Old Marex ordinary shares received New Marex shares on a one-for-one basis. New Marex assumed all obligations under existing indentures and outstanding senior notes, including $600 million of 6.404% Senior Notes due 2029, through supplemental indentures. This is a routine corporate restructuring for tax or regulatory purposes, not a special situation. No shareholder vote or premium is involved.
